create_LARS_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer instance with custom learning rate, weight decay, and momentum for PyTorch model training
run_clip_gradients: run gradient clipping on a PyTorch model to cap gradient norms and return the list of per-parameter norms
initialize_trunc_normal_tensor: initialize a PyTorch tensor with truncated normal distribution values using specified mean, std, and bounds
build_cosine_scheduler: build a cosine annealing schedule with optional warmup for learning rate or weight decay across training epochs
compute_learning_schedule: compute the learning rate at a given global step using linear warmup followed by cosine decay
